title: A warm winter for every cat
body: This season of blessings, help us keep our rescues warm, fed and cared for. Sponsor a cat through the cold months, or meet one who is still waiting for a second chance.
story_quote: Every cat I rescue deserves more than just surviving. My promise to them is a safe home, real care, and a future they can count on.
story_by: Dina, founder of Furry Hearts of Jordan
